name: Harmonic Picks
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Picks from your whole USB library that fit the playing deck by key and BPM; press one to load it.
description:
Test build 0.2.2, not yet run on a deck. Mod Menu > Harmonic picks. Searches your whole rekordbox library on both USBs, not one playlist: up to 40 tracks in the same, a neighbour or the relative key of the deck that started last, within the BPM range (3, 6 or 10%; half and double time count). Green = same key, VOX = acapella.

Knob: move. Press a pick to load it on a stopped deck (never a playing one); it finds it in a playlist of up to 256 rows. Grey picks say "search": find those by hand. Touching a control stops a load.
